Sharon Stone's Top 10 Movies Ranked

Discover top Sharon Stone movies from her iconic career. From steamy Basic Instinct to Oscar-nominated Casino, Sharon Stone movies captivate viewers. Experience her in Total Recall, The Quick and the Dead, and The Muse. Stone's powerful performances define Hollywood glamour and versatility.

6 July 2023 · RewindZone Archive

Sharon Stone exploded onto the scene in 1992 with her star-making turn in Basic Instinct. Her provocative performance instantly made her a Hollywood icon. Though she's continued to take on bold, challenging roles over her 30-plus-year career, Stone has never quite matched that early buzz and curiosity. Of course, her acting talents prove she's a true original who still has nothing left to prove. To appreciate what made Stone such an unpredictable and fascinating force, we've ranked her top 10 movies. From cult classics to award winners, these films spotlight just how captivating and audacious she was on the big screen.

10. The Mighty (1998)

In this heartwarming drama, Stone plays the caring mother of a disabled son. Her emotional performance depicts the challenges and triumphs of parenthood.

"Sharon Stone's portrayal in 'The Mighty' is a testament to her versatility as an actress. She brings depth and vulnerability to Gwen Dillon, capturing the essence of a woman grappling with both personal struggles and the unconditional love she has for her child."

Key Points

  • Portrays the role of Gwen Dillon, a mother navigating raising her disabled son
  • Brings depth and vulnerability to the character
  • Showcases Stone's versatility and emotional range

9. Above the Law (1988)

Stone plays Sally, the strong-willed wife of a martial arts legend caught in a dangerous conspiracy, in this early action film that helped launch her career.

"One of Sharon Stone's greatest performances can be seen in the intense interrogation scene where she fearlessly defends her husband against corrupt forces."

Key Points

  • The intense interrogation scene displays Stone's fearlessness
  • Established her as an actress to watch in the action genre

8. The Specialist (1994)

Stone seeks revenge alongside Sylvester Stallone in this tense action thriller. Her depth and on-screen chemistry shine.

"Stone's ability to convey both strength and emotional complexity truly shines in 'The Specialist.'"

Key Points

  • Conveys emotional complexity amid the intense storyline
  • Stone had palpable chemistry with Stallone

7. Broken Flowers (2005)

Stone delivers a subtle yet affecting performance as Murray's mysterious former lover, who still carries unresolved feelings.

"Throughout the movie, Stone shares poignant scenes with Murray that are filled with tension and unresolved feelings from their past relationship. The chemistry between the two actors is palpable, creating a sense of authenticity in their interactions."

Key Points

  • The emotional range on display in poignant scenes
  • Showcases versatility in indie film

6. The Muse (1999)

Stone glides through this comedic film as an enchanting muse who helps inspire struggling artists to create again.

"With her impeccable charm and captivating allure, Stone effortlessly embodies Sarah's ethereal nature. Her portrayal is both mesmerising and compelling, as she brings depth to a character that could have easily been one-dimensional."

Key Points

  • A light-hearted role shows comedic abilities
  • Excellent chemistry with co-star Albert Brooks

5. The Quick and the Dead (1995)

Stone commands the screen as a vengeful gunslinger in this slick Western thriller.

"Sharon Stone's portrayal of Ellen is utterly captivating, as she effortlessly embodies the fierce determination and resilience of her character. Her on-screen presence is nothing short of mesmerising, commanding attention with every scene she appears in."

Key Points

  • Mesmerizing presence and steely resolve
  • Showcases exceptional acting abilities

4. Antz (1998)

Stone brings charisma and complexity to her vocal performance as the spirited Princess Bala in this animated comedy.

"Stone injects vibrancy and depth into her character, capturing the audience's attention with her mesmerizing vocal performance...Stone demonstrates yet again why she is one of Hollywood's most talented actresses."

Key Points

  • Memorable vocal performance in the animated film
  • Adds depth and strength to her princess character

3. Total Recall (1990)

Stone delivers' a masterful, multifaceted performance as Schwarzenegger's seemingly loving, then manipulative wife.

"Stone's portrayal of Lori is masterful and multifaceted. She effortlessly transitions from playing a caring and supportive wife to revealing her true nature as a manipulative and deceptive character."

Key Points

  • Showcases versatility
  • Conveys shifting emotional complexity

2. Casino (1995)

Stone gives a career-defining performance as the glamorous trophy wife of an ambitious casino boss, showcasing her acting range.

"From her initial seductive allure to the heartbreaking moments of betrayal and despair, Stone's portrayal keeps viewers on the edge of their seats throughout the film. Undoubtedly one of Sharon Stone's most memorable films, Casino solidified her status as an A-list actress in Hollywood."

Key Points

  • Captivating presence and undeniable talent
  • Flawlessly navigates complex emotional arcs

1. Basic Instinct (1992)

Stone captivates in her star-making turn as provocative novelist Catherine Tramell in this erotic thriller.

"With its tantalising plot, provocative scenes, and Stone's mesmerising portrayal of Catherine Tramell, a seductive crime novelist entangled in a web of murder and intrigue, 'Basic Instinct' remains an absolute must-watch for any fan of thrilling cinema."

Key Points

  • Established her as a Hollywood icon
  • Powerful, magnetic, and cunning performance

Conclusion

Sharon Stone is an incredible actress known for her powerful performances in iconic films like "Basic Instinct" and "Casino." Her talent and versatility have left a lasting impact on audiences. From her captivating portrayal of Catherine Tramell in "Basic Instinct" to her Academy Award-nominated role in "Casino," Stone brings depth and charisma to her characters. Her filmography also includes timeless classics like "Total Recall" and "The Quick and the Dead," where she showcases her versatility in different genres. Sharon Stone's talent and range make her performances unforgettable. Discover her filmography and experience the magic of cinema with this Hollywood icon.

Trending Sharon Stone FAQs

Q: What caused Sharon Stone's stroke?

A: Sharon Stone suffered a stroke in September 2001, which was caused by a ruptured vertebral artery. This health incident resulted in a life-threatening situation and required immediate medical attention. Thankfully, Stone received prompt medical care and made a remarkable recovery.

Q: What was Sharon Stone's first movie?

A: Sharon Stone's first significant film role was in the movie "Stardust Memories," directed by Woody Allen, and released in 1980. Although it was a relatively small role, it marked the beginning of her acting career and set the stage for her future success in the film industry.

Q: What is Sharon Stone famous for?

A: Sharon Stone is a renowned American actress, producer, and former fashion model. She rose to international fame with her iconic performance as Catherine Tramell in the film "Basic Instinct," where her role garnered significant attention and became one of her most memorable portrayals. Stone is also recognised for her remarkable performances in movies such as "Casino" (1995), "Total Recall" (1990), and "The Specialist" (1994). Throughout her career, she has been acclaimed for her talent, beauty, and captivating on-screen presence.
